labels[\"d\"]) if np.isfinite(v)}\n\n\ndef model_run(\n    bundle: dict[str, Any],\n    factor_entries: dict[int, dict[str, Any]],\n    rank_by_origin: dict[int, int],\n    labels: pd.DataFrame,\n    use_control: bool,\n    start_label_month: str,\n) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    panel: pd.DataFrame = bundle[\"model_panel\"]\n    features: pd.DataFrame = bundle[\"features\"]\n    rs: pd.DataFrame = bundle[\"regime_schedule\"]\n    month_idx = d.month_index(panel[\"month\"].tolist())\n    lmap = label_map(labels)\n\n    # control series (lag 0)\n    ctrl_raw = features[CONTROL].to_numpy(float)\n\n    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    coef_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    fold_detail: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n\n    for row in rs.itertuples(index=False):\n        t = int(row.origin_idx)\n        origin_month = str(row.origin_month)\n        target_month = str(row.target_period)\n        entry = factor_entries[t]\n        pipe = entry[\"pipe\"]\n        F_all = entry[\"F\"]\n        r = int(rank_by_origin[t])\n\n        # Training label months u <= origin month; predictor origin s = u-1.\n        train_u = [\n            m for m in panel[\"month\"].tolist()\n            if start_label_month <= m <= origin_month and m in lmap\n        ]\n        if not train_u:\n            raise RuntimeError(f\"no training labels at {row.forecast_origin}\")\n\n        s_idx = np.asarray([month_idx[m] - 1 for m in train_u], dtype=int)\n        if np.any(s_idx < 0):\n            raise RuntimeError(\"training predictor index before sample start\")\n        if np.any(s_idx >= t):\n            raise RuntimeError(\"training predictor origin not before the forecast origin\")\n\n        Xf = F_all[s_idx][:, :r]\n        y = np.asarray([lmap[m] for m in train_u], dtype=float)\n\n        control_used = bool(use_control)\n        if control_used:\n            raw = ctrl_raw[s_idx]\n            ok = np.isfinite(raw)\n            if ok.sum() < len(raw) or int(np.sum(y[ok])) < 3:\n                # Documented fallback: too few usable control observations or\n                # positives; keep the fold estimable with factors only.\n                control_used = False\n            else:\n                mu_c = float(np.mean(raw[ok]))\n                sd_c = float(np.std(raw[ok], ddof=1))\n                if not np.isfinite(sd_c) or sd_c <= 0:\n                    control_used = False\n                else:\n                    ctrl_train = (raw - mu_c) / sd_c\n\n        if control_used:\n            raw_test = ctrl_raw[t]\n            if not np.isfinite(raw_test):\n                control_used = False\n\n        if control_used:\n            X = np.column_stack([Xf, ctrl_train])\n            x_test = np.concatenate([F_all[t][:r], [(ctrl_raw[t] - mu_c) / sd_c]])\n            terms = [\"const\"] + [f\"f{k}\" for k in range(1, r + 1)] + [\"lpr_1y_z\"]\n        else:\n            X = Xf\n            x_test = F_all[t][:r]\n            terms = [\"const\"] + [f\"f{k}\" for k in range(1, r + 1)]\n\n        fit = fit_probit(X, y)\n        beta = fit[\"beta\"]\n        p = float(norm.cdf(np.r_[1.0, x_test] @ beta))\n        base_rate = float(np.mean(y))\n        y_true = float(lmap[target_month])\n        thresh_class = int(p >= 0.5)\n\n        rows.append({\n            \"model\": \"probit\",\n            \"forecast_origin\": row.forecast_origin,\n            \"target_period\": target_month,\n            \"y_true\": y_true,\n            \"y_pred_proba\": p,\n            \"y_pred\": thresh_class,\n            \"fold\": str(row.fold),\n            \"seed\": int(bundle.get(\"seed\", 42)),\n            \"leakage_discipline\": \"safe\",\n            \"train_start\": train_u[0],\n            \"train_end\": train_u[-1],\n            \"n_train_labels\": int(len(train_u)),\n            \"n_positive\": int(np.sum(y)),\n            \"base_rate\": base_rate,\n            \"r\": r,\n            \"control_used\": control_used,\n            \"fit_method\": fit[\"method\"],\n            \"y_lag1\": float(lmap.get(panel.iloc[t][\"month\"], np.nan)) if panel.iloc[t][\"month\"] in lmap else np.nan,\n        })\n\n        for k, term in enumerate(terms):\n            coef_rows.append({\n                \"fold\": str(row.fold),\n                \"forecast_origin\": row.forecast_origin,\n                \"term\": term,\n                \"coef\": float(beta[k]) if k < len(beta) else np.nan,\n                \"se\": float(fit[\"se\"][k]) if k < len(fit[\"se\"]) else np.nan,\n                \"t_stat\": float(fit[\"t\"][k]) if k < len(fit[\"t\"]) else np.nan,\n                \"n_train\": int(len(train_u)),\n                \"n_positive\": int(np.sum(y)),\n                \"r\": r,\n                \"control_used\": control_used,\n                \"fit_method\": fit[\"method\"],\n            })\n\n        fold_detail.append({\n            \"fold\": str(row.fold),\n            \"forecast_origin\": row.forecast_origin,\n            \"target_period\": target_month,\n            \"train_start\": train_u[0],\n            \"train_end\": train_u[-1],\n            \"n_train_labels\": int(len(train_u)),\n            \"n_positive\": int(np.sum(y)),\n            \"r\": r,\n            \"control_used\": control_used,\n            \"fit_method\": fit[\"method\"],\n        })\n\n    preds = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n    coefs = pd.DataFrame(coef_rows)\n    if len(preds) != 82:\n        raise RuntimeError(f\"regime model must produce 82 predictions, got {len(preds)}\")\n    if preds[\"y_pred_proba\"].isna().any():\n        raise RuntimeError(\"NaN predicted probabilities\")\n\n    metrics = regime_metrics(preds)\n    return {\n        \"predictions\": preds,\n        \"coefficients\": coefs,\n        \"folds\": pd.DataFrame(fold_detail),\n        \"metrics\": metrics,\n        \"use_control\": use_control,\n        \"start_label_month\": start_label_month,\n    }\n\n\ndef regime_metrics(preds: pd.DataFrame) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    y = preds[\"y_true\"].to_numpy(float)\n    p = preds[\"y_pred_proba\"].to_numpy(float)\n    cls = (p >= 0.5).astype(int)\n\n    brier = float(np.mean((p - y) ** 2))\n    auc = float(roc_auc_score(y, p)) if len(np.unique(y)) == 2 else float(\"nan\")\n    acc = float(np.mean(cls == y))\n    tp = int(np.sum((cls == 1) & (y == 1)))\n    tn = int(np.sum((cls == 0) & (y == 0)))\n    fp = int(np.sum((cls == 1) & (y == 0)))\n    fn = int(np.sum((cls == 0) & (y == 1)))\n    sens = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) else float(\"nan\")\n    spec = tn / (tn + fp) if (tn + fp) else float(\"nan\")\n    bal = float(np.nanmean([sens, spec]))\n    ll = float(log_loss(y, np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12), labels=[0, 1]))\n\n    # prior-frequency baseline on the same folds\n    prior_p = preds[\"base_rate\"].to_numpy(float)\n    prior_cls = (prior_p >= 0.5).astype(int)\n    prior_brier = float(np.mean((prior_p - y) ** 2))\n    prior_acc = float(np.mean(prior_cls == y))\n    prior_auc = float(roc_auc_score(y, prior_p)) if len(np.unique(y)) == 2 else float(\"nan\")\n\n    # persistence baseline: predict d_{t+1} = d_t\n    lag = preds[\"y_lag1\"].to_numpy(float)\n    ok = np.isfinite(lag)\n    persist_brier = float(np.mean((lag[ok] - y[ok]) ** 2)) if ok.any() else float(\"nan\")\n    persist_acc = float(np.mean((lag[ok] >= 0.5) == (y[ok] >= 0.5))) if ok.any() else float(\"nan\")\n    persist_auc = float(roc_auc_score(y[ok], lag[ok])) if ok.sum() and len(np.unique(y[ok])) == 2 else float(\"nan\")\n\n    # yearly blocks\n    yearly: dict[str, Any] = {}\n    dft = preds.copy()\n    dft[\"year\"] = dft[\"target_period\"].str[:4]\n    for year, g in dft.groupby(\"year\"):\n        yy = g[\"y_true\"].to_numpy(float)\n        pp = g[\"y_pred_proba\"].to_numpy(float)\n        yearly[year] = {\n            \"n\": int(len(g)),\n            \"brier\": float(np.mean((pp - yy) ** 2)),\n            \"auc\": float(roc_auc_score(yy, pp)) if len(np.unique(yy)) == 2 else None,\n            \"accuracy\": float(np.mean((pp >= 0.5).astype(int) == yy)),\n        }\n\n    return {\n        \"overall\": {\n            \"n\": int(len(preds)),\n            \"n_positive\": int(np.sum(y)),\n            \"n_negative\": int(np.sum(1 - y)),\n            \"brier\": brier,\n            \"auc\": auc,\n            \"accuracy\": acc,\n            \"balanced_accuracy\": bal,\n            \"sensitivity\": float(sens),\n            \"specificity\": float(spec),\n            \"log_loss\": ll,\n            \"confusion\": {\"tp\": tp, \"tn\": tn, \"fp\": fp, \"fn\": fn},\n        },\n        \"baseline_prior_frequency\": {\n            \"brier\": prior_brier,\n            \"auc\": prior_auc,\n            \"accuracy\": prior_acc,\n            \"note\": \"per-fold training base rate used as the constant probability\",\n        },\n        \"baseline_persistence\": {\n            \"brier\": persist_brier,\n            \"auc\": persist_auc,\n            \"accuracy\": persist_acc,\n            \"note\": \"predict d_(t+1) = d_t; probabilities are 0/1\",\n            \"n_evaluated\": int(ok.sum()),\n        },\n        \"brier_skill_score_vs_prior\": 1.0 - brier / prior_brier if prior_brier > 0 else float(\"nan\"),\n        \"by_year\": yearly,\n    }\n\n\ndef coefficient_tables(coefs: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:\n    final_fold = coefs[\"fold\"].iloc[-1]\n    final = coefs[coefs[\"fold\"] == final_fold].copy()\n    final = final[[\"fold\", \"forecast_origin\", \"term\", \"coef\", \"se\", \"t_stat\", \"n_train\", \"n_positive\", \"r\", \"control_used\", \"fit_method\"]]\n\n    summary_rows = []\n    for term, g in coefs.groupby(\"term\"):\n        vals = g[\"coef\"].dropna().to_numpy(float)\n        summary_rows.append({\n            \"term\": term,\n            \"n_folds\": int(len(vals)),\n            \"mean_coef\": float(np.mean(vals)) if len(vals) else np.nan,\n            \"sd_coef\": float(np.std(vals, ddof=1)) if len(vals) > 1 else np.nan,\n            \"min_coef\": float(np.min(vals)) if len(vals) else np.nan,\n            \"max_coef\": float(np.max(vals)) if len(vals) else np.nan,\n            \"sign_stability\": float(np.mean(np.sign(vals) == np.sign(np.mean(vals)))) if len(vals) and np.mean(vals) != 0 else np.nan,\n        })\n    return final, pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Figures\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef write_fig(fig: go.Figure, path: Path) -> None:\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    fig.write_html(str(path), include_plotlyjs=True, full_html=True)\n\n\ndef make_probability_figure(preds: pd.DataFrame) -> None:\n    fig = make_subplots(specs=[[{\"secondary_y\": True}]])\n    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=preds[\"target_period\"], y=preds[\"y_pred_proba\"], mode=\"lines+markers\",\n                             name=\"P(contraction)\"), secondary_y=False)\n    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=preds[\"target_period\"], y=preds[\"y_true\"], mode=\"markers\",\n                             name=\"Realized d(t+1)\", marker=dict(symbol=\"x\", size=7, color=\"black\")),\n                  secondary_y=True)\n    fig.add_hline(y=0.5, line_dash=\"dash\", line_color=\"grey\", secondary_y=False)\n    fig.update_layout(title=\"Probit contraction probability, expanding walk-forward\",\n                      xaxis_title=\"Target month\", template=\"plotly_white\", hovermode=\"x unified\",\n                      xaxis=dict(tickangle=45))\n    fig.update_yaxes(title_text=\"Probability\", range=[0, 1], secondary_y=False)\n    fig.update_yaxes(title_text=\"Realized label\", range=[-0.1, 1.1], secondary_y=True, showgrid=False)\n    write_fig(fig, FIG_DIR / \"fig_regime_probabilities.html\")\n\n\ndef make_roc_figure(preds: pd.DataFrame) -> None:\n    y = preds[\"y_true\"].to_numpy(float)\n    p = preds[\"y_pred_proba\"].to_numpy(float)\n    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y, p)\n    fig = go.Figure()\n    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=fpr, y=tpr, mode=\"lines\", name=f\"Probit (AUC={roc_auc_score(y, p):.3f})\"))\n    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[0, 1], y=[0, 1], mode=\"lines\", name=\"Chance\", line=dict(dash=\"dash\", color=\"grey\")))\n    fig.update_layout(title=\"ROC - pooled 82 out-of-sample target months\",\n                      xaxis_title=\"False positive rate\", yaxis_title=\"True positive rate\",\n                      template=\"plotly_white\")\n    write_fig(fig, FIG_DIR / \"fig_regime_roc.html\")\n\n\ndef make_calibration_figure(preds: pd.DataFrame) -> None:\n    df = preds.copy()\n    df[\"bin\"] = pd.qcut(df[\"y_pred_proba\"], q=min(5, df[\"y_pred_proba\"].nunique()), duplicates=\"drop\")\n    g = df.groupby(\"bin\", observed=True).agg(p=(\"y_pred_proba\", \"mean\"), y=(\"y_true\", \"mean\"), n=(\"y_true\", \"size\")).reset_index()\n    fig = go.Figure()\n    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=g[\"p\"], y=g[\"y\"], mode=\"lines+markers+text\",\n                             text=[f\"n={n}\" for n in g[\"n\"]], textposition=\"top center\", name=\"Reliability\"))\n    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[0, 1], y=[0, 1], mode=\"lines\", name=\"Perfect calibration\",\n                             line=dict(dash=\"dash\", color=\"grey\")))\n    fig.update_layout(title=\"Calibration (quantile bins of predicted probability)\",\n                      xaxis_title=\"Mean predicted probability\", yaxis_title=\"Observed contraction frequency\",\n                      template=\"plotly_white\")\n    write_fig(fig, FIG_DIR / \"fig_regime_calibration.html\")\n\n\ndef make_brier_figure(preds: pd.DataFrame) -> None:\n    df = preds.copy()\n    df[\"fold_brier\"] = (df[\"y_pred_proba\"] - df[\"y_true\"]) ** 2\n    df[\"prior_brier\"] = (df[\"base_rate\"] - df[\"y_true\"]) ** 2\n    df[\"rolling_model\"] = df[\"fold_brier\"].rolling(6, min_periods=1).mean()\n    df[\"rolling_prior\"] = df[\"prior_brier\"].rolling(6, min_periods=1).mean()\n    fig = go.Figure()\n    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=df[\"target_period\"], y=df[\"fold_brier\"], name=\"Fold Brier\", opacity=0.35))\n    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=df[\"target_period\"], y=df[\"rolling_model\"], mode=\"lines\", name=\"Probit (6m mean)\"))\n    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=df[\"target_period\"], y=df[\"rolling_prior\"], mode=\"lines\", name=\"Prior baseline (6m mean)\"))\n    fig.update_layout(title=\"Fold-level Brier score vs prior-frequency baseline\",\n                      xaxis_title=\"Target month\", yaxis_title=\"Brier score\",\n                      template=\"plotly_white\", xaxis=dict(tickangle=45))\n    write_fig(fig, FIG_DIR / \"fig_regime_brier.html\")\n\n\ndef make_coef_figure(final: pd.DataFrame) -> None:\n    df = final[final[\"term\"] != \"const\"].copy()\n    fig = go.Figure()\n    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(\n        x=df[\"term\"], y=df[\"coef\"],\n        error_y=dict(type=\"data\", array=1.96 * df[\"se\"], visible=True),\n        name=\"Coefficient (95% CI)\",\n    ))\n    fig.add_hline(y=0, line_color=\"grey\")\n    fig.update_layout(title=\"Final-fold Probit coefficients with standard errors\",\n                      xaxis_title=\"Term\", yaxis_title=\"Coefficient\",\n                      template=\"plotly_white\")\n    write_fig(fig, FIG_DIR / \"fig_regime_coefficients.html\")\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Main\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef run(seed: int) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    t0 = time.perf_counter()\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n\n    CONSOLE.print(Panel.fit(\n        \"[bold]Option A - Probit contraction classifier[/bold]\\n\"\n        f\"seed={seed} | 82 target months | 2020-01 to 2026-10\",\n        border_style=\"cyan\",\n    ))\n\n    bundle = d.run(seed=seed, write=False, verbose=False)\n    bundle[\"seed\"] = seed\n    panel: pd.DataFrame = bundle[\"model_panel\"]\n    features: pd.DataFrame = bundle[\"features\"]\n    rs: pd.DataFrame = bundle[\"regime_schedule\"]\n    target: pd.DataFrame = bundle[\"target\"]\n    month_idx = d.month_index(panel[\"month\"].tolist())\n\n    factor_indicators = [c for c in bundle[\"indicators\"] if c not in d.RATE_BLOCK]\n    cache = RegimeFactorCache(features, factor_indicators)\n    qmap = build_quarter_maps(target, panel)\n\n    # Rank selection is label-independent: use the GDP nowcast criterion once\n    # per monthly origin, then reuse it for both thresholds/specifications.\n    rank_by_origin: dict[int, int] = {}\n    rank_detail: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    entries: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}\n    for origin_idx in sorted(rs[\"origin_idx\"].astype(int).unique()):\n        entry = cache.get(origin_idx)\n        entries[int(origin_idx)] = entry\n        train_q = observable_quarters(qmap, int(origin_idx))\n        max_rank = min(d.MAX_FACTORS, entry[\"pipe\"][\"max_components\"])\n        best_r, detail = select_rank(cache, qmap, int(origin_idx), train_q, max_rank)\n        rank_by_origin[int(origin_idx)] = int(best_r)\n        for rec in detail:\n            rank_detail.append({\n                \"origin_month\": panel.iloc[int(origin_idx)][\"month\"],\n                **rec,\n            })\n\n    labels50: pd.DataFrame = bundle[\"labels50\"]\n    labels495: pd.DataFrame = bundle[\"labels495\"]\n\n    primary = model_run(bundle, entries, rank_by_origin, labels50, use_control=True,\n                        start_label_month=\"2008-02\")\n    factors_only = model_run(bundle, entries, rank_by_origin, labels50, use_control=False,\n                             start_label_month=\"2008-02\")\n    sens495 = model_run(bundle, entries, rank_by_origin, labels495, use_control=True,\n                        start_label_month=\"2008-02\")\n    sens495_fo = model_run(bundle, entries, rank_by_origin, labels495, use_control=False,\n                           start_label_month=\"2008-02\")\n\n    final50, summary50 = coefficient_tables(primary[\"coefficients\"])\n    final495, summary495 = coefficient_tables(sens495[\"coefficients\"])\n\n    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    FIG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    primary[\"predictions\"].to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"predictions.csv\", index=False)\n    primary[\"coefficients\"].to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"coefficients.csv\", index=False)\n    final50.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"coefficients_final.csv\", index=False)\n    summary50.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"coefficients_summary.csv\", index=False)\n    primary[\"folds\"].to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"folds.csv\", index=False)\n\n    factors_only[\"predictions\"].to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"predictions_factors_only.csv\", index=False)\n    sens495[\"predictions\"].to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"predictions_threshold_49p5.csv\", index=False)\n    sens495_fo[\"predictions\"].to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"predictions_threshold_49p5_factors_only.csv\", index=False)\n    final495.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"coefficients_final_threshold_49p5.csv\", index=False)\n\n    # preprocessing provenance for the primary factor model\n    prep_rows = []\n    for oi, entry in sorted(entries.items()):\n        pipe = entry[\"pipe\"]\n        for j, name in enumerate(pipe[\"retained\"]):\n            prep_rows.append({\n                \"origin_month\": panel.iloc[oi][\"month\"],\n                \"indicator\": name,\n                \"retained\": True,\n                \"mu\": float(pipe[\"mu\"][j]),\n                \"sd\": float(pipe[\"sd\"][j]),\n                \"n_train_months\": int(pipe[\"n_train\"]),\n                \"r_selected\": int(rank_by_origin[oi]),\n                \"variance_explained_selected\": d.factor_variance_ratio(pipe, int(rank_by_origin[oi])),\n            })\n    pd.DataFrame(prep_rows).to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"preprocessing.csv\", index=False)\n\n    fit_seconds = time.perf_counter() - t0\n\n    def payload(result: dict[str, Any], threshold: float, spec: str) -> dict[str, Any]:\n        final, summary = coefficient_tables(result[\"coefficients\"])\n        return {\n            \"task\": \"regime_classification\",\n            \"target\": f\"pmi_contraction_next_{str(threshold).replace('.', 'p')}\",\n            \"approach\": \"A\",\n            \"leakage_discipline\": \"safe\",\n            \"seed\": seed,\n            \"params\": {\n                \"model\": \"Probit: P(d_(t+1)=1) = Phi(beta' z_t)\",\n                \"label_definition\": \"d_t = 1{pmi_man_t < threshold and pmi_man_(t-1) < threshold}\",\n                \"threshold\": threshold,\n                \"z_t\": \"PCA factors\" + (\" + lpr_1y control (training-standardized)\" if spec == \"factors_plus_lpr\" else \" only\"),\n                \"factor_universe\": \"panel excluding the rate/spread block reserved for controls\",\n                \"control\": CONTROL if spec == \"factors_plus_lpr\" else None,\n                \"factor_screen\": {\n                    \"recent_months\": d.SCREEN_RECENT_MONTHS,\n                    \"min_recent_coverage\": d.SCREEN_MIN_RECENT_COVERAGE,\n                    \"min_observations\": d.SCREEN_MIN_OBSERVATIONS,\n                },\n                \"rank_candidates\": list(range(1, d.MAX_FACTORS + 1)),\n                \"rank_selection\": \"inner expanding-window CV, pooled M1/M2/M3 GDP nowcast RMSE\",\n                \"train_label_start\": result[\"start_label_month\"],\n                \"initial_label_window\": [d.REGIME_INIT_START, d.REGIME_INIT_END],\n                \"oos_target_months\": [d.REGIME_OOS_START, d.REGIME_OOS_END],\n                \"forecast_origins\": \"month-end 2019-12-31 … 2026-09-30\",\n                \"decision_threshold\": 0.5,\n            },\n            \"metrics\": result[\"metrics\"],\n            \"folds\": result[\"folds\"].to_dict(orient=\"records\"),\n            \"rank_path\": [\n                {\"origin_month\": panel.iloc[oi][\"month\"], \"r\": int(r)}\n                for oi, r in sorted(rank_by_origin.items())\n            ],\n            \"rank_cv_detail\": rank_detail,\n            \"coefficients_final\": final.to_dict(orient=\"records\"),\n            \"coefficients_summary\": summary.to_dict(orient=\"records\"),\n            \"fit_seconds\": fit_seconds,\n            \"environment\": {\"python\": sys.version.split()[0], \"numpy\": np.__version__, \"pandas\": pd.__version__},\n            \"outputs\": {\n                \"predictions\": \"results/approach1/regime/predictions.csv\",\n                \"coefficients\": \"results/approach1/regime/coefficients.csv\",\n            },\n        }\n\n    primary_payload = payload(primary, 50.0, \"factors_plus_lpr\")\n    primary_payload[\"sensitivity_threshold_49p5\"] = {\n        \"file\": \"metrics_threshold_49p5.json\",\n        \"metrics\": sens495[\"metrics\"],\n        \"factors_only_metrics\": sens495_fo[\"metrics\"],\n        \"note\": \"49.5 labels are reconstructed independently on the same calendar schedule.\",\n    }\n    primary_payload[\"sensitivity_factors_only\"] = {\n        \"file\": \"metrics_factors_only.json\",\n        \"metrics\": factors_only[\"metrics\"],\n    }\n    d.write_json(OUT_DIR / \"metrics.json\", primary_payload)\n    d.write_json(OUT_DIR / \"metrics_factors_only.json\", payload(factors_only, 50.0, \"factors_only\"))\n    d.write_json(OUT_DIR / \"metrics_threshold_49p5.json\", payload(sens495, 49.5, \"factors_plus_lpr\"))\n    d.write_json(OUT_DIR / \"metrics_threshold_49p5_factors_only.json\", break\n\n    if len(retained) < 3:\n        raise RuntimeError(\"fewer than 3 indicators retained after screening\")\n    return masked[retained].dropna(), retained, audit, dropped\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Clustering and verification\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef correlation_distance(X: pd.DataFrame) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, dict[str, float]]:\n    Z = (X - X.mean()) / X.std(ddof=1)\n    R = np.corrcoef(Z.to_numpy(dtype=float), rowvar=False)\n    D = np.sqrt(np.maximum(0.0, 2.0 * (1.0 - R)))\n    np.fill_diagonal(D, 0.0)\n\n    eig = np.linalg.eigvalsh(R)\n    U = Z.to_numpy(dtype=float)\n    U = U / np.linalg.norm(U, axis=0, keepdims=True)\n    D_euclid = squareform(pdist(U.T, metric=\"euclidean\"))\n    max_diff = float(np.max(np.abs(D - D_euclid)))\n\n    checks = {\n        \"min_eigenvalue\": float(eig.min()),\n        \"max_eigenvalue\": float(eig.max()),\n        \"psd_ok\": bool(eig.min() >= -1e-10),\n        \"euclidean_max_abs_diff\": max_diff,\n        \"euclidean_ok\": bool(max_diff < 1e-10),\n        \"symmetric\": bool(np.allclose(D, D.T, atol=1e-12)),\n        \"zero_diagonal\": bool(np.allclose(np.diag(D), 0.0)),\n    }\n    return R, D, checks\n\n\ndef ward_and_silhouette(D: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    condensed = squareform(D, checks=False)\n    Z = linkage(condensed, method=\"ward\")\n    n = D.shape[0]\n    k_max = min(K_MAX, n - 1)\n    curves = []\n    for k in range(2, k_max + 1):\n        labels = fcluster(Z, k, criterion=\"maxclust\")\n        sil = float(silhouette_score(D, labels, metric=\"precomputed\"))\n        curves.append({\"k\": k, \"silhouette\": sil})\n    best = max(curves, key=lambda x: (x[\"silhouette\"], -x[\"k\"]))\n    labels_best = fcluster(Z, int(best[\"k\"]), criterion=\"maxclust\")\n    labels_fixed = fcluster(Z, min(K_FIXED, k_max), criterion=\"maxclust\")\n    sil_fixed = float(silhouette_score(D, labels_fixed, metric=\"precomputed\")) if len(set(labels_fixed)) > 1 else float(\"nan\")\n    return {\n        \"linkage\": Z,\n        \"k_curve\": curves,\n        \"k_selected\": int(best[\"k\"]),\n        \"silhouette_selected\": float(best[\"silhouette\"]),\n        \"silhouette_k4\": sil_fixed,\n        \"labels_selected\": labels_best,\n        \"labels_k4\": labels_fixed,\n    }\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# GDP lead-lag and regime profile\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef quarterly_aggregate(panel: pd.DataFrame, indicators: list[str], end_idx: int) -> pd.DataFrame:\n    rows = []\n    for i in range(end_idx + 1):\n        month = panel.iloc[i][\"month\"]\n        q = d.quarter_from_month(month)\n        rows.append({\"quarter\": q, **{c: panel.iloc[i][c] for c in indicators}})\n    long = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n    out = long.groupby(\"quarter\", sort=True)[indicators].mean(numeric_only=True)\n    return out\n\n\ndef gdp_quarter_map(target: pd.DataFrame, panel: pd.DataFrame, end_idx: int) -> dict[str, float]:\n    idx = d.month_index(panel[\"month\"].tolist())\n    out = {}\n    for row in target.itertuples(index=False):\n        if not np.isfinite(row.gdp_yoy_single_derived):\n            continue\n        em = d.quarter_end_month(row.quarter)\n        if em not in idx:\n            continue\n        if idx[em] + d.GDP_PUBLICATION_LAG_MONTHS <= end_idx:\n            out[row.quarter] = float(row.gdp_yoy_single_derived)\n    return out\n\n\ndef lead_lag_table(\n    panel: pd.DataFrame,\n    target: pd.DataFrame,\n    window_end: str,\n    end_idx: int,\n    indicators: list[str],\n) -> pd.DataFrame:\n    qx = quarterly_aggregate(panel, indicators, end_idx)\n    gmap = gdp_quarter_map(target, panel, end_idx)\n    gq = pd.Series(gmap)\n    rows = []\n    for c in indicators:\n        if c not in qx.columns:\n            continue\n        for lag in range(-LEAD_LAG, LEAD_LAG + 1):\n            pairs = []\n            for q in qx.index:\n                gq_series = gq.copy()\n                # align indicator at q with GDP at q+lag\n                q_target = str(pd.Period(q, freq=\"Q\") + lag)\n                if q in qx.index and q_target in gq.index:\n                    xv = qx.loc[q, c]\n                    gv = gq.loc[q_target]\n                    if np.isfinite(xv) and np.isfinite(gv):\n                        pairs.append((float(xv), float(gv)))\n            if len(pairs) >= MIN_LEAD_LAG_OBS:\n                arr = np.asarray(pairs, float)\n                corr = float(np.corrcoef(arr[:, 0], arr[:, 1])[0, 1])\n            else:\n                corr = np.nan\n            rows.append({\n                \"window_end\": window_end,\n                \"indicator\": c,\n                \"lag_quarters\": lag,\n                \"corr\": corr,\n                \"n_obs\": len(pairs),\n            })\n    return pd.DataFrame(rows)\n\n\ndef regime_profile(\n    masked_panel: pd.DataFrame,\n    labels: pd.DataFrame,\n    window_end: str,\n    cluster_map: dict[str, int],\n) -> pd.DataFrame:\n    lab = labels.set_index(\"month\")[\"d\"]\n    rows = []\n    for c, cid in cluster_map.items():\n        s = masked_panel[c].dropna()\n        months = s.index.map(lambda i: masked_panel.loc[i, \"month\"]) if \"month\" in masked_panel.columns else None\n        # masked_panel passed here includes only indicator columns; use the\n        # label alignment by position instead.\n        rows.append((c, cid))\n    # Build alignment explicitly using the caller-provided frame with month.\n    return pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=[\"indicator\", \"cluster_id\"])\n\n\ndef cluster_profile_table(\n    window_frame: pd.DataFrame,\n    labels: pd.DataFrame,\n    window_end: str,\n    clusters: pd.DataFrame,\n) -> pd.DataFrame:\n    lab = labels.set_index(\"month\")[\"d\"]\n    frame = window_frame.copy()\n    frame[\"d\"] = [lab.get(m, np.nan) for m in frame[\"month\"]]\n    rows = []\n    for cid, g in clusters.groupby(\"cluster_id\"):\n        members = list(g[\"indicator\"])\n        zcols = []\n        for c in members:\n            x = frame[c]\n            z = (x - x.mean()) / x.std(ddof=1) if x.std(ddof=1) > 0 else x * 0\n            zcols.append(z)\n        if not zcols:\n            continue\n        Z = pd.concat(zcols, axis=1)\n        Z.columns = members\n        dvals = frame[\"d\"]\n        con = Z.loc[dvals == 1].mean()\n        exp = Z.loc[dvals == 0].mean()\n        rows.append({\n            \"window_end\": window_end,\n            \"cluster_id\": int(cid),\n            \"n_members\": int(len(members)),\n            \"mean_z_contraction\": float(con.mean()),\n            \"mean_z_expansion\": float(exp.mean()),\n            \"difference\": float(con.mean() - exp.mean()),\n            \"members\": \";\".join(members),\n        })\n    return pd.DataFrame(rows)\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Figures\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef write_fig(fig: go.Figure, path: Path) -> None:\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    fig.write_html(str(path), include_plotlyjs=True, full_html=True)\n\n\ndef make_dendrogram_figure(window_results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:\n    n = len(window_results)\n    cols = 3\n    rows = int(np.ceil(n / cols))\n    fig = make_subplots(rows=rows, cols=cols, subplot_titles=[w[\"window_end\"] for w in window_results],\n                        vertical_spacing=0.06, horizontal_spacing=0.04)\n    for i, w in enumerate(window_results):\n        r = i // cols + 1\n        c = i % cols + 1\n        dg = dendrogram(w[\"linkage\"], no_plot=True)\n        for xs, ys in zip(dg[\"icoord\"], dg[\"dcoord\"]):\n            fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=xs, y=ys, mode=\"lines\", line=dict(color=\"#2c7fb8\", width=1),\n                                     hoverinfo=\"skip\", showlegend=False), row=r, col=c)\n    fig.update_layout(title=\"Ward dendrograms for each valid rolling 36-month window\",\n                      template=\"plotly_white\", height=320 * rows, width=1100,\n                      margin=dict(t=70, b=30))\n    fig.update_xaxes(showticklabels=False)\n    write_fig(fig, FIG_DIR / \"fig_dendrograms.html\")\n\n\ndef make_silhouette_figure(sil_df: pd.DataFrame) -> None:\n    fig = go.Figure()\n    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=sil_df[\"window_end\"], y=sil_df[\"silhouette_selected\"], name=\"Selected k\"))\n    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=sil_df[\"window_end\"], y=sil_df[\"silhouette_k4\"], mode=\"lines+markers\", name=\"Fixed k=4\"))\n    fig.update_layout(title=\"Silhouette score by rolling window\", xaxis_title=\"Window end\",\n                      yaxis_title=\"Silhouette (correlation distance)\", template=\"plotly_white\",\n                      xaxis=dict(tickangle=45))\n    write_fig(fig, FIG_DIR / \"fig_silhouette.html\")\n\n\ndef make_k_curve_figure(window_results: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:\n    fig = go.Figure()\n    for w in window_results:\n        df = pd.DataFrame(w[\"k_curve\"])\n        fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=df[\"k\"], y=df[\"silhouette\"], mode=\"lines+markers\", name=w[\"window_end\"]))\n    fig.update_layout(title=\"Silhouette vs number of clusters\", xaxis_title=\"k\", yaxis_title=\"Silhouette\",\n                      template=\"plotly_white\")\n    write_fig(fig, FIG_DIR / \"fig_silhouette_k_curve.html\")\n\n\ndef make_ari_figure(ari: pd.DataFrame) -> None:\n    fig = go.Figure()\n    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=ari[\"window_curr\"], y=ari[\"ari\"], name=\"Adjacent ARI\"))\n    fig.add_hline(y=0, line_color=\"grey\")\n    fig.update_layout(title=\"Adjacent-window cluster stability (common indicators)\",\n                      xaxis_title=\"Window end\", yaxis_title=\"Adjusted Rand index\",\n                      template=\"plotly_white\", xaxis=dict(tickangle=45))\n    write_fig(fig, FIG_DIR / \"fig_adjacent_ari.html\")\n\n\ndef make_membership_figure(clusters: pd.DataFrame) -> None:\n    piv = clusters.pivot(index=\"indicator\", columns=\"window_end\", values=\"cluster_id\")\n    fig = go.Figure(data=go.Heatmap(z=piv.values, x=list(piv.columns), y=list(piv.index),\n                                    colorscale=\"Viridis\", colorbar=dict(title=\"cluster\"),\n                                    hoverongaps=False))\n    fig.update_layout(title=\"Cluster membership by window (blank = not retained)\",\n                      xaxis_title=\"Window end\", yaxis_title=\"Indicator\",\n                      template=\"plotly_white\", height=max(550, 18 * len(piv.index)),\n                      xaxis=dict(tickangle=45))\n    write_fig(fig, FIG_DIR / \"fig_cluster_membership.html\")\n\n\ndef make_lead_lag_figure(lead: pd.DataFrame, window_end: str) -> None:\n    df = lead[lead[\"window_end\"] == window_end]\n    if df.empty:\n        return\n    piv = df.pivot(index=\"indicator\", columns=\"lag_quarters\", values=\"corr\")\n    fig = go.Figure(data=go.Heatmap(z=piv.values, x=list(piv.columns), y=list(piv.index),\n                                    colorscale=\"RdBu\", zmid=0, colorbar=dict(title=\"corr\")))\n    fig.update_layout(title=f\"Indicator vs GDP lead-lag correlation (window ending {window_end})\",\n                      xaxis_title=\"GDP lead (-) / lag (+) in quarters\", yaxis_title=\"Indicator\",\n                      template=\"plotly_white\", height=max(550, 18 * len(piv.index)))\n    write_fig(fig, FIG_DIR / \"fig_lead_lag_gdp.html\")\n\n\ndef make_profile_figure(profile: pd.DataFrame, window_end: str) -> None:\n    df = profile[profile[\"window_end\"] == window_end]\n    if df.empty:\n        return\n    fig = go.Figure()\n    fig.add_trace(go.Bar(x=df[\"cluster_id\"], in contraction vs expansion (window ending {window_end})\",\n                      xaxis_title=\"Cluster\", yaxis_title=\"Mean standardized level\",\n                      barmode=\"group\", ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef run(seed: int) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    t0 = time.perf_counter()\n    np.random.seed(seed)\n\n    CONSOLE.print(Panel.fit(\n        \"[bold]Option A - rolling 3-year Ward clustering[/bold]\\n\"\n        f\"seed={seed} | 36-month windows | step {STEP_MONTHS}m | d_ij=sqrt(2(1-rho))\",\n        border_style=\"cyan\",\n    ))\n\n    bundle = d.run(seed=seed, write=False, verbose=False)\n    panel: pd.DataFrame = bundle[\"model_panel\"]\n    target: pd.DataFrame = bundle[\"target\"]\n    lags: dict[str, int] = bundle[\"lags\"]\n    indicators: list[str] = bundle[\"indicators\"]\n    labels50: pd.DataFrame = bundle[\"labels50\"]\n\n    ends = window_ends(panel)\n    window_results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    silhouette_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    cluster_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    retention_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    lead_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n    profile_rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []\n\n    for end_month in ends:\n        start_idx, end_idx, start_month, _ = window_bounds(panel, end_month)\n        masked = mask_asof_window(panel, lags, indicators, start_idx, end_idx)\n        Xc, retained, audit, dropped = screen_and_clean(masked, indicators)\n        n_common = len(Xc)\n        if n_common < 24:\n            raise RuntimeError(f\"window {end_month}: only {n_common} common months\")\n\n        R, D, checks = correlation_distance(Xc)\n        if not (checks[\"psd_ok\"] and checks[\"euclidean_ok\"]):\n            raise RuntimeError(f\"window {end_month}: Euclidean compatibility failed: {checks}\")\n\n        ward = ward_and_silhouette(D)\n        labels = ward[\"labels_selected\"]\n\n        for c, cid in zip(retained, labels):\n            cluster_rows.append({\n                \"window_end\": end_month,\n                \"window_start\": start_month,\n                \"indicator\": c,\n                \"cluster_id\": int(cid),\n                \"k_selected\": int(ward[\"k_selected\"]),\n            })\n        for row in audit.to_dict(orient=\"records\"):\n            retention_rows.append({\"window_end\": end_month, **row})\n\n        silhouette_rows.append({\n            \"window_end\": end_month,\n            \"window_start\": start_month,\n            \"n_retained\": int(len(retained)),\n            \"n_common_months\": int(n_common),\n            \"n_dropped_collinear\": int(len(dropped)),\n            \"dropped_collinear\": \";\".join(dropped),\n            \"min_eigenvalue\": checks[\"min_eigenvalue\"],\n            \"psd_ok\": checks[\"psd_ok\"],\n            \"euclidean_max_abs_diff\": checks[\"euclidean_max_abs_diff\"],\n            \"euclidean_ok\": checks[\"euclidean_ok\"],\n            \"k_selected\": ward[\"k_selected\"],\n            \"silhouette_selected\": ward[\"silhouette_selected\"],\n            \"silhouette_k4\": ward[\"silhouette_k4\"],\n        })\n\n        # lead-lag with GDP (as of window end)\n        lead = lead_lag_table(panel, target, end_month, end_idx, retained)\n        lead_rows.append(lead)\n\n        # cluster-level lead-lag and contraction profile\n        cluster_map = dict(zip(retained, labels))\n        cl_rows = []\n        for cid in sorted(set(int(x) for x in labels)):\n            members = [c for c in retained if cluster_map[c] == cid]\n            sub = lead[lead[\"indicator\"].isin(members)]\n            if sub.empty:\n                continue\n            mean_by_lag = sub.groupby(\"lag_quarters\")[\"corr\"].mean()\n            best_lag = int(mean_by_lag.abs().idxmax())\n            cl_rows.append({\n                \"window_end\": end_month,\n                \"cluster_id\": cid,\n                \"n_members\": len(members),\n                \"best_lag_quarters\": best_lag,\n                \"max_abs_mean_corr\": float(abs(mean_by_lag.loc[best_lag])),\n                \"mean_corr_at_best\": float(mean_by_lag.loc[best_lag]),\n                \"members\": \";\".join(members),\n            })\n        if cl_rows:\n            pd.DataFrame(cl_rows).to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"_tmp_cluster_lead.csv\", index=False)\n\n        # regime profile: build a frame with month + retained indicators\n        frame = panel.iloc[start_idx:end_idx + 1][[\"month\"] + retained].copy()\n        clusters = pd.DataFrame({\"indicator\": retained, \"cluster_id\": labels})\n        prof = cluster_profile_table(frame, labels50, end_month, clusters)\n        profile_rows.append(prof)\n\n        window_results.append({\n            \"window_end\": end_month,\n            \"window_start\": start_month,\n            \"retained\": retained,\n            \"dropped\": dropped,\n            \"n_common_months\": n_common,\n            \"checks\": checks,\n            \"linkage\": ward[\"linkage\"],\n            \"k_curve\": ward[\"k_curve\"],\n            \"k_selected\": ward[\"k_selected\"],\n            \"silhouette_selected\": ward[\"silhouette_selected\"],\n            \"silhouette_k4\": ward[\"silhouette_k4\"],\n            \"labels\": labels,\n ignore_index=True) if lead_rows else pd.DataFrame()\n    profile_df = pd.concat(profile_rows, ignore_index=True) if profile_rows else pd.DataFrame()\n\n    # Adjacent-window ARI on the common retained universe.\n    ari_rows = []\n    for prev, curr in zip(window_results[:-1], window_results[1:]):\n        common = sorted(set(prev[\"retained\"]) & set(curr[\"retained\"]))\n        if len(common) < 2:\n            ari_rows.append({\n                \"window_prev\": prev[\"window_end\"], \"window_curr\": curr[\"window_end\"],\n                \"n_common_indicators\": len(common), \"ari\": np.nan,\n                \"common_indicators\": \";\".join(common),\n            })\n            continue\n        p = prev[\"labels\"][[prev[\"retained\"].index(c) for c in common]]\n        q = curr[\"labels\"][[curr[\"retained\"].index(c) for c in common]]\n        ari_rows.append({\n            \"window_prev\": prev[\"window_end\"],\n            \"window_curr\": curr[\"window_end\"],\n            \"n_common_indicators\": len(common),\n            \"ari\": float(adjusted_rand_score(p, q)),\n            \"common_indicators\": \";\".join(common),\n        })\n    ari_df = pd.DataFrame(ari_rows)\n\n    # Cluster-level lead-lag aggregate from the per-window table.\n    cluster_lead_rows = []\n    for w in window_results:\n        sub = lead_df[lead_df[\"window_end\"] == w[\"window_end\"]]\n        for cid in sorted(set(int(x) for x in w[\"labels\"])):\n            members = [c for c, x in zip(w[\"retained\"], w[\"labels\"]) if int(x) == cid]\n            ss = sub[sub[\"indicator\"].isin(members)]\n            if ss.empty:\n                continue\n            mean_by_lag = ss.groupby(\"lag_quarters\")[\"corr\"].mean()\n            if = pd.DataFrame(cluster_lead_rows)\n\n    # ---- writes ------------------------------------------------------------\n    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    FIG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, cluster_lead_df.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"cluster_lead_lag.csv\", index=False)\n    profile_df.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"cluster_regime_profile.csv\", index=False)\n\n    fit_seconds = time.perf_counter() - t0\n | Regime classification | `code/approach1_regime.py` | Probit with LPR 1Y control, 82 walk-forward folds, prior/persistence baselines, coefficient tables with SEs, 49.5 sensitivity, factors-only sensitivity |
| Indicator clustering | `code/approach1_cluster.py` | 17 rolling 36-month windows, 95% coverage rule, exact-collinearity screen, PSD/Euclidean verification, Ward, silhouette, adjacent ARI, GDP lead–lag |
| Independent validation | `code/approach1_validate.py` | Recomputes every headline metric from row-level predictions, audits leakage, re-verifies clustering geometry |
| Comparison layer | `code/compare.py` | Task-separated consolidated report; Option B placeholder without invented numbers; three-layer clustering framework |
| One-command reproduction | `code/run_option_a.py` | Runs the full pipeline in order |

`AGENTS.md` run commands and the `README.md` reproduction command were added only after the commands were verified.

## Key results

### GDP nowcasting (2018Q1–2026Q3, 105 records)

| Vintage | RMSE | MAE | RW-drift RMSE |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| M1 | 3.2142 | 1.3351 | 4.1549 |
| M2 | 2.6593 | 1.2363 | 4.1549 |
| M3 | 3.2642 | 1.4938 | 4.1549 |
| Overall | **3.0582** | **1.3551** | 4.1549 |

- MSE skill vs RW-drift: **0.458**.
- Mean absolute M1→M3 revision: **0.850 pp**.
- 48.6% of quarters improved from M1 to M3.
- Selected rank: 3 in 90 records, 4 in 15 records.
- The 2020Q1 M3 nowcast is a documented limitation of the static latest-value factor: the March PMI rebound enters, but the February collapse does not.

### Regime classification (82 target months)

| Model | Brier | AUC | Accuracy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Probit, factors + LPR 1Y (primary) | 0.2517 | 0.5953 | 0.5976 |
| Probit, factors only | 0.2220 | 0.6357 | 0.5976 |
| Prior-frequency baseline | 0.2321 | 0.5997 | 0.6707 |
| Persistence baseline | 0.2439 | 0.7239 | 0.7561 |
| 49.5 threshold, factors only | 0.1471 | 0.6221 | 0.8293 |
| 49.5 threshold, LPR control | 0.1446 | 0.6912 | 0.7927 |

**Important factual finding:** the primary static Probit does **not** beat the prior-frequency or persistence baselines, and its AUC is below the assignment's indicative 0.75 benchmark. This is reported, not hidden. The 49.5 models have zero sensitivity at the 0.5 threshold because contractions are very sparse (13 positives).

### Indicator clustering

- 17 windows, 36 months each, 12-month step.
- 15–21 indicators retained per window (mean 17.8); 35 common months per window.
- Mean silhouette **0.2405**; mean adjacent ARI **0.2383**.
- Minimum correlation eigenvalue **7.49e-4**; all windows PSD.
- Maximum Euclidean-identity error **2.83e-15**; the required `d_ij = sqrt(2(1-rho_ij))` is exactly Euclidean-compatible under the common-sample rule.
- Final window: clusters split into prices/external-sector (10 indicators) and PMI/money/credit (9 indicators), with GDP lead–lag peaks at −1 and 0 quarters.

## Unresolved issues

1. **Regime performance is weak.** The primary Probit AUC is 0.595, below the indicative 0.75 and below the persistence baseline (0.724). A likely extension is lagged factors or explicit PMI persistence controls, but that changes the approved static specification and needs group approval.
2. **49.5 sensitivity is sparse.** Only 13 OOS contractions; the 0.5 decision threshold yields zero sensitivity. AUC/Brier are the more informative diagnostics there.
3. **Option B is absent.** `results/comparison.html` contains a clear placeholder; the three-layer A/B comparison cannot be completed until Option B metrics exist. No cross-method ARI/NMI was computed.
4. **Clustering universes are coverage-dependent.** Early windows retain 15–16 indicators, not the full 30-column panel. This is documented per window.
5. **Single data vintage.** Only publication lags, not true real-time data vintages, are modelled.
6. **Derived GDP target** is a chain-linked arithmetic estimate, not an official separately published single-quarter series; labelled accordingly.
7. **`report.md` and `SESSION.md`** remain group deliverables; I did not touch them.

PART 1 — AUDIT THE EXISTING PROBIT ESTIMATION

The existing implementation appears to suppress warnings and may mark a fit as successful without explicitly checking the optimizer's convergence status. Verify this carefully.

For each fold, inspect and record:

- Actual optimizer convergence status.
- Number of iterations and relevant optimizer return information.

- Whether the Newton or BFGS optimizer was used.

- Whether coefficients are unusually large or unstable across folds.

Do not assume that a fit failed merely because its predictions are extreme. Distinguish confirmed convergence failures from potential instability.

Do not change the original primary estimation procedure during this audit. Report the findings separately and explain whether the existing primary results are numerically trustworthy.

PART 2 — SENSITIVITY EXPERIMENT 1: INNER-CV SELECTION OF PROBIT FACTOR COUNT

The current primary Probit uses the factor count selected by the GDP nowcasting procedure.

Keep that existing specification as the primary model.

As a separate sensitivity experiment, test whether the Probit factor count can be selected more appropriately using classification performance.

Requirements:

1. Use the same 82 outer walk-forward forecast folds, target months, forecast origins, labels, and evaluation observations as the existing primary Probit.
2. For each outer fold, select the number of PCA factors using inner expanding-window classification cross-validation based ONLY on the historical training data available at that outer forecast origin.
3. Candidate factor counts should be limited to valid dimensions supported by the existing feature construction and training sample. Do not introduce arbitrary additional specifications.
4. Use inner-CV Brier score as the primary selection criterion. Record the scores for all candidate factor counts and the selected count for each outer fold.
5. Do not use the outer-fold test observation, the full OOS sample, or OOS AUC to select the factor count.
6. If an inner-CV selection cannot be performed reliably for a particular fold, use the existing GDP-nowcast-selected rank as a documented fallback rather than using future information.
7. Preserve the original feature timing, PCA preprocessing, standardization, label alignment, and leakage protections.

Evaluate the resulting OOS predictions on exactly the same 82 observations as the existing primary model.

PART 3 — SENSITIVITY EXPERIMENT 2: DYNAMIC PROBIT WITH LAGGED FACTORS

Test a dynamic Probit specification that includes:

- Current PCA factors.
- One-month-lagged PCA factors.
- The existing LPR 1Y control.

Keep the existing target definition and forecast timing unchanged.

For clarity, the current model predicts d_(t+1) using information available at month t. Therefore:

- The prediction for d_(t+1) should use factors at t and t-1, together with LPR 1Y at t.
- A historical training observation for d_u should use factors at u-1 and u-2, together with LPR 1Y at u-1.

Ensure that all PCA transformations, standardization, and feature construction remain leakage-safe within each outer fold. The lagged factors must be generated consistently from the same permissible PCA basis for that fold.

Do not use future observations to construct lagged features or fit preprocessing parameters.

Because this specification has more regressors and the training sample is relatively small, pay particular attention to convergence, coefficient stability, and potential overfitting. Do not silently change the specification or introduce unreported regularization.

PART 4 — EVALUATION AND COMPARISON

For both sensitivity experiments, evaluate predictions on the exact same 82 OOS observations and compare them with:

- Existing primary Probit.
- Prior-frequency baseline.
- Persistence baseline.

Report at least:

- Brier score.
- AUC.
- Accuracy.
- Balanced accuracy.
- Confusion matrix or sensitivity and specificity at the existing classification threshold.
- Number of valid OOS observations.
- Number of positive and negative labels.

Retain the existing 49.5 PMI threshold sensitivity results as a separate reference where appropriate. Do not mix results from different target definitions.

Explain the differences between probability calibration, ranking performance, and classification accuracy. In particular, do not interpret a higher accuracy at a fixed threshold as sufficient evidence of a better probabilistic model.

PART 5 — OUTPUTS AND VALIDATION

Save all new code and results separately. Do not overwrite existing primary files.

### Audited fit function

```
def audited_fit(X, y, lam=1e-4):
    import statsmodels.api as sm
    from statsmodels.tools.sm_exceptions import PerfectSeparationError
    Xc = sm.add_constant(X, has_constant='add')
    attempts=[]
    for method in ('newton','bfgs'):
        with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
            warnings.simplefilter('always')
            try:
                res = sm.Probit(y, Xc).fit(method=method, maxiter=2000, disp=0)
            except Exception as e:
                attempts.append({'method':method,'error':repr(e),'warnings':[str(x.message) for x in w]})
                continue
            ret = getattr(res,'mle_retvals',{}) or {}
            converged = ret.get('converged', getattr(res,'converged',None))
            ...
            return dict(...)
    # ridge
    ...
```

### Metrics and Brier decomposition

```
def evaluate(y,p,threshold=0.5):
  brier = mean((p-y)^2)
  auc = roc_auc_score if both classes
  cls = p>=threshold
  acc, sens, spec, bal
  confusion
  logloss
  brier decomposition:
    bins = pd.qcut(p, q=10, duplicates='drop') or equal width
    ...
```
For persistence, p is 0/1; qcut with duplicates may fail. Use equal-width bins [0,0.1,...1] or a single bin. For decomposition, use 10 equal-width bins. If a bin empty, skip. For p=0/1, bins at 0 and 1. Fine.
- `uncertainty = ybar*(1-ybar)`.
- `reliability = sum(n_k/n)*(p_k - y_k)^2`.
- `resolution = sum(n_k/n)*(y_k - ybar)^2`.
- `brier = reliability - resolution + uncertainty`.
- Check decomposition tolerance.

- Calibration-in-the-large = mean(p) - mean(y).
- Calibration slope: logistic regression of y on logit(p) with p clipped; if p constant or separation, skip. Could use sklearn LogisticRegression with no penalty? Not necessary. Brier decomposition + mean p vs mean y is enough.
- Report `mean_pred`, `observed_rate`.

\"hessian_cond\": np.nan,\n        \"hessian_pd\": None,\n        \"warnings\": \" | \".join(msgs),\n        \"n_warnings\": len(msgs),\n        \"beta\": beta,\n        \"se\": se,\n        \"t\": np.asarray(rp[\"t\"], float),\n        \"loglik\": float(rp.get(\"loglik\", np.nan)),\n        \"n_train\": int(len(y)),\n        \"train_prob_min\": float(np.min(p)),\n        \"train_prob_max\":   primary = pd.read_csv(PRIMARY_DIR / \"predictions.csv\").set_index(\"target_period\")\n\n    rows = []\n    coef_rows = []\n    pred_rows = []\n\n    for row in rs.itertuples(index=False):\n        t = int(row.origin_idx)\n        origin_month = str(row.origin_month)\n        target = str(row.target_period)\n        entry = entries[t]\n        F = entry[\"F\"]\n        pipe = entry[\"pipe\"]\n        r = int(ctx[\"rank_primary\"][origin_month])\n        ft = fold_training(ctx, origin_month)\n        s_idx = ft[\"s_idx\"]\n        y = ft[\"y\"]\n        train_u = ft[\"train_u\"]\n\n        raw = lpr[s_idx]\n        mu_c = float(np.mean(raw))\n        sd_c = float(np.std(raw, ddof=1))\n        X = np.column_stack([F[s_idx][:, :r], (raw - mu_c) / sd_c])\n        x_test = np.concatenate([F[t][:r], [(lpr[t] - mu_c) / sd_c]])\n        terms = [\"const\"] + [f\"f{k}\" for k in range(1, r + 1)] + [\"lpr_1y_z\"]\n\n        fit = audited_fit(X, y)\n        beta = fit[\"beta\"]\n        p = float(norm.cdf(np.r_[1.0, x_test] @ beta))\n        p_primary = float(primary.loc[target, \"y_pred_proba\"])\n        diff = abs(p - p_primary)\n\n        n_pos = int(np.sum(y))\n        n_neg = int(len(y) - n_pos)\n        max_abs_coef = float(np.max(np.abs(beta)))\n        max_abs_t = float(np.nanmax(np.abs(fit[\"t\"])))\n        unstable_flags = []\n        if fit[\"converged\"] is False:\n            unstable_flags.append(\"nonconverged\")\n        if fit[\"warnflag\"] not in (None, 0):\n            unstable_flags.append(\"warnflag\")\n        if fit[\"n_warnings\"] > 0:\n            unstable_flags.append(\"warnings\")\n        if fit[\"hessian_cond\"] is not None and np.isfinite(fit[\"hessian_cond\"]) and fit[\"hessian_cond\"] > 1e6:\n            unstable_flags.append(\"ill_conditioned_hessian\")\n        if fit[\"hessian_pd\"] is False:\n            unstable_flags.append(\"hessian_not_pd\")\n        if max_abs_t > 10:\n            unstable_flags.append(\"large_t\")\n        if max_abs_coef > 10:\n            unstable_flags.append(\"large_coef\")\n        if fit[\"train_prob_extreme_share\"] > 0.25:\n            unstable_flags.append(\"many_extreme_train_probs\")\n        if n_pos < 5 or n_neg < 5:\n            unstable_flags.append(\"few_class_observations\")\n        if fit[\"accepted_method\"] == \"ridge_probit_fallback\":\n            unstable_flags.append(\"ridge_fallback\")\n\n        rows.append({\n            \"fold\": str(row.fold),\n            \"target_period\": target,\n            \"forecast_origin\": row.forecast_origin,\n            \"origin_month\": origin_month,\n            \"r\": r,\n            \"n_train\": len(y),\n            \"n_positive\": n_pos,\n            \"n_negative\": n_neg,\n            \"accepted_method\": fit[\"accepted_method\"],\n            \"converged\": fit[\"converged\"],\n            \"converged_source\": fit[\"converged_source\"],\n            \"iterations\": fit[\"iterations\"],\n            \"fcalls\": fit[\"fcalls\"],\n            \"warnflag\": fit[\"warnflag\"],\n            \"fopt\": fit[\"fopt\"],\n            \"score_norm\": fit[\"score_norm\"],\n            \"hessian_min_eig\": fit[\"hessian_min_eig\"],\n            \"hessian_max_eig\": fit[\"hessian_max_eig\"],\n            \"hessian_cond\": fit[\"hessian_cond\"],\n            \"hessian_pd\": fit[\"hessian_pd\"],\n            \"n_warnings\": fit[\"n_warnings\"],\n            \"warnings\": fit[\"warnings\"],\n            \"max_abs_coef\": max_abs_coef,\n            \"max_abs_se\": float(np.nanmax(np.abs(fit[\"se\"]))),\n            \"max_abs_t\": max_abs_t,\n            \"train_prob_min\": fit[\"train_prob_min\"],\n            \"train_prob_max\": fit[\"train_prob_max\"],\n            \"train_prob_extreme_share\": fit[\"train_prob_extreme_share\"],\n            \"test_prob\": p,\n            \"primary_prob\": p_primary,\n            \"abs_diff_primary\": diff,\n            \"nonconverged\": fit[\"converged\"] is False,\n            \"fallback_triggered\": fit[\"accepted_method\"] == \"ridge_probit_fallback\",\n            \"potential_instability\": \";\".join(unstable_flags),\n            \"bfgs_diagnostic_converged\": fit.get(\"bfgs_diagnostic_converged\", None),\n            \"bfgs_diagnostic_max_abs_beta_diff\": fit.get(\"bfgs_diagnostic_max_abs_beta_diff\", np.nan),\n            \"bfgs_diagnostic_warnings\": fit.get(\"bfgs_diagnostic_warnings\", \"\"),\n            \"attempt_log\": fit.get(\"attempt_log\", \"\"),\n        })\n\n        for k, term in enumerate(terms):\n            coef_rows.append({\n                \"fold\": str(row.fold),\n                \"target_period\": target,\n                \"forecast_origin\": row.forecast_origin,\n                \"term\": term,\n                \"coef\": float(beta[k]) if k < len(beta) else np.nan,\n                \"se\": float(fit[\"se\"][k]) if k < len(fit[\"se\"]) else np.nan,\n                \"t_stat\": float(fit[\"t\"][k]) if k < len(fit[\"t\"]) else np.nan,\n                \"r\": r,\n                \"accepted_method\": fit[\"accepted_method\"],\n                \"converged\": fit[\"converged\"],\n            })\n\n        pred_rows.append({\n            \"model\": \"probit_primary_audited\",\n 0.5),\n            \"fold\": str(row.fold),\n            \"seed\": ctx[\"seed\"],\n            \"r\": r,\n        })\n\n    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n    coefs = pd.DataFrame(coef_rows)\n    preds = add(\"n_folds_with_warnings\", int((df[\"n_warnings\"] > 0).sum()))\n    add(\"n_ridge_fallbacks\", int(df[\"fallback_triggered\"].sum()))\n    add(\"n_nonconverged\", float(df[\"hessian_cond\"].median()))\n    add(\"hessian_cond_max\", float(df[\"hessian_cond\"].max()))\n    add(\"hessian_min_eig_min\", float(df[\"hessian_min_eig\"].min()))\n    add(\"max_abs_coef_max\", float(df[\"max_abs_coef\"].max()))\n    add(\"max_abs_t_max\", float(df[\"max_abs_t\"].max()))\n    add(\"train_prob_min_min\", float(df[\"train_prob_min\"].min()))\n    add(\"train_prob_max_max\", float(df[\"train_prob_max\"].max()))\n    add(\"n_folds_train_prob_extreme_share_gt_0.25\", int((df[\"train_prob_extreme_share\"] > 0.25).sum()))\n    add(\"test_prob_min\", float(df[\"test_prob\"].min()))\n    add(\"test_prob_max\", float(df[\"test_prob\"].max()))\n    add(\"n_test_prob_below_0.01\", int((df[\"test_prob\"] < 0.01).sum()))\n    add(\"n_test_prob_above_0.99\", int((df[\"test_prob\"] > 0.99).sum()))\n    add(\"max_abs_diff_vs_primary\", float(df[\"abs_diff_primary\"].max()))\n    add(\"n_abs_diff_vs_primary_gt_1e-8\", ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef fast_probit_fit(X: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray | None:\n    import statsmodels.api as sm\n    Xc = sm.add_constant(X, has_constant=\"add\")\n    with warnings.catch_warnings():\n        warnings.simplefilter(\"ignore\")\n        for method in (\"newton\", \"bfgs\"):\n            try:\n                res = sm.Probit(y, Xc).fit(method=method, maxiter=300, disp=0)\n                beta = np.asarray(res.params, float)\n                if np.all(np.isfinite(beta)):\n                    return beta\n            except Exception:\n                continue\n    return None\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# PART 2 - inner-CV classification rank selection\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef inner_cv_rank(ctx: dict[str, Any], origin_month: str, t: int, r_primary: int) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    entry = ctx[\"entries\"][t]\n    F = entry[\"F\"]\n    lpr = ctx[\"lpr\"]\n    ft = fold_training(ctx, origin_month)\n    train_u, s_idx, y = ft[\"train_u\"], ft[\"s_idx\"], ft[\"y\"]\n    n = len(train_u)\n    r_max = int(min(MAX_R, entry[\"pipe\"][\"max_components\"], max(1, n - MIN_INNER_TRAIN - 1)))\n    r_candidates = list(range(1, r_max + 1))\n\n    Ftr = F[s_idx]\n    ctrl = lpr[s_idx]\n    sse = {r: 0.0 for r in r_candidates}\n    counts = {r: 0 for r in r_candidates}\n    n_inner = 0\n\n    for k in range(MIN_INNER_TRAIN, n):\n        y_in = y[:k]\n        if len(np.unique(y_in)) < 2 or int(np.sum(y_in)) < 5 or int(np.sum(1 - y_in)) < 5:\n            continue\n        raw_in = ctrl[:k]\n        mu = float(np.mean(raw_in))\n        sd = float(np.std(raw_in, ddof=1))\n        if not np.isfinite(sd) or sd <= 0:\n            continue\n        ctrl_z_in = (raw_in - mu) / sd\n        ctrl_z_val = (ctrl[k] - mu) / sd\n        ok = True\n        local_pred = {}\n        for r in r_candidates:\n            X = np.column_stack([Ftr[:k, :r], ctrl_z_in])\n            beta = fast_probit_fit(X, y_in)\n            if beta is None or not np.all(np.isfinite(beta)):\n                ok = False\n                break\n            xv = np.r_[1.0, Ftr[k, :r], ctrl_z_val]\n            local_pred[r] = float(norm.cdf(xv @ beta))\n        if not ok:\n            continue\n        n_inner += 1\n        for r in r_candidates:\n            sse[r] += (local_pred[r] - y[k]) ** 2\n            counts[r] += 1\n\n    briers = {r: (sse[r] / counts[r] if counts[r] > 0 else np.nan) for r in r_candidates}\n    valid = [(r, b) for r, b in briers.items() if np.isfinite(b)]\n    fallback = False\n    if n_inner < MIN_INNER_FOLDS or not valid:\n        selected = int(r_primary)\n        fallback = True\n    else:\n        selected = int(min(valid, key=lambda rb: (rb[1], rb[0]))[0])\n\n    return {\n        \"forecast_origin\": d.month_end(origin_month),\n        \"origin_month\": origin_month,\n        \"target_period\": None,\n        \"n_train\": n,\n        \"n_inner_folds\": n_inner,\n        \"r_primary\": int(r_primary),\n        \"r_selected\": selected,\n        \"fallback_to_primary\": fallback,\n        \"inner_brier_selected\": briers.get(selected, np.nan),\n        \"inner_brier_primary\": briers.get(r_primary, np.nan),\n        \"r_candidates\": r_candidates,\n        \"inner_brier_by_r\": briers,\n        \"n_by_r\": counts,\n        \"pca_basis_fit_origin\": origin_month,\n    }\n\n\ndef run_rank_selection(ctx: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    rs = ctx[\"schedule\"]\n    lmap = ctx[\"lmap\"]\n    records = []\n    long_rows = []\n    preds = []\n    conv_rows = []\n\n    for row in rs.itertuples(index=False):\n        t = int(row.origin_idx)\n        origin_month = str(row.origin_month)\n        target = str(row.target_period)\n        r_primary = int(ctx[\"rank_primary\"][origin_month])\n        sel = inner_cv_rank(ctx, origin_month, t, r_primary)\n        sel[\"target_period\"] = target\n        records.append({k: v for k, v in sel.items() if k not in (\"r_candidates\", \"inner_brier_by_r\", \"n_by_r\")})\n        for r in sel[\"r_candidates\"]:\n            long_rows.append({\n                \"target_period\": target,\n                \"origin_month\": origin_month,\n                \"forecast_origin\": row.forecast_origin,\n                \"candidate_r\": int(r),\n                \"inner_brier\": sel[\"inner_brier_by_r\"].get(r, np.nan),\n                \"n_inner\": sel[\"n_by_r\"].get(r, 0),\n                \"r_primary\": r_primary,\n                \"r_selected\": sel[\"r_selected\"],\n                \"fallback_to_primary\": sel[\"fallback_to_primary\"],\n            })\n\n        # OOS prediction with the selected rank, same outer training sample and basis.\n        entry = ctx[\"entries\"][t]\n        F = entry[\"F\"]\n        lpr = ctx[\"lpr\"]\n        ft = fold_training(ctx, origin_month)\n        s_idx, y = ft[\"s_idx\"], ft[\"y\"]\n        raw = lpr[s_idx]\n        mu = float(np.mean(raw))\n        sd = float(np.std(raw, ddof=1))\n        r = int(sel[\"r_selected\"])\n        X = np.column_stack([F[s_idx][:, :r], (raw - mu) / sd])\n        fit = fit_probit(X, y)\n        beta = np.asarray(fit[\"beta\"], float)\n        x_test = np.r_[1.0, F[t][:r], (lpr[t] - mu) / sd]\n        p = float(norm.cdf(x_test @ beta))\n        preds.append({\n            \"model\": \"probit_inner_cv_rank\",\n            \"forecast_origin\": row.forecast_origin,\n            \"target_period\": target,\n            \"y_true\": float(lmap[target]),\n            \"y_pred_proba\": p,\n            \"y_pred\": int(p >= 0.5),\n            \"fold\": str(row.fold),\n            \"seed\": ctx[\"seed\"],\n            \"r\": r,\n            \"r_primary\": r_primary,\n            \"fallback_to_primary\": bool(sel[\"fallback_to_primary\"]),\n        })\n        conv_rows.append({\n            \"target_period\": target,\n            \"forecast_origin\": row.forecast_origin,\n            \"r_selected\": r,\n            \"r_primary\": r_primary,\n            \"fit_method\": fit[\"method\"],\n            \"converged\": fit.get(\"converged\", None),\n            \"n_train\": len(y),\n            \"n_positive\": int(np.sum(y)),\n        })\n\n    sel_df = pd.DataFrame(records)\n    long_df = pd.DataFrame(long_rows)\n    pred_df = pd.DataFrame(preds)\n    conv_df = pd.DataFrame(conv_rows)\n    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    sel_df.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"probit_inner_cv_rank_selection.csv\", index=False)\n    long_df.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"probit_inner_cv_rank_curve.csv\", index=False)\n    pred_df.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"probit_inner_cv_predictions.csv\", index=False)\n    conv_df.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"probit_inner_cv_fit_convergence.csv\", index=False)\n    return {\"selection\": sel_df, \"curve\": long_df, \"predictions\": pred_df, \"convergence\": conv_df}\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# PART 3 - dynamic Probit\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef run_dynamic(ctx: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    rs = ctx[\"schedule\"]\n    lmap = ctx[\"lmap\"]\n    lpr = ctx[\"lpr\"]\n    preds = []\n    conv_rows = []\n    coef_rows = []\n\n    for row in rs.itertuples(index=False):\n        t = int(row.origin_idx)\n        origin_month = str(row.origin_month)\n        target = str(row.target_period)\n        r = int(ctx[\"rank_primary\"][origin_month])\n        entry = ctx[\"entries\"][t]\n        F = entry[\"F\"]\n        ft = fold_training(ctx, origin_month)\n        s_idx, y, train_u = ft[\"s_idx\"], ft[\"y\"], ft[\"train_u\"]\n        if np.any(s_idx - 1 < 0):\n            raise RuntimeError(\"dynamic lag would precede the sample\")\n        raw = lpr[s_idx]\n        mu = float(np.mean(raw))\n        sd = float(np.std(raw, ddof=1))\n        X = np.column_stack([F[s_idx][:, :r], F[s_idx - 1][:, :r], (raw - mu) / sd])\n        x_test = np.concatenate([F[t][:r], F[t - 1][:r], [(lpr[t] - mu) / sd]])\n        terms = ([\"const\"] + [f\"f{k}\" for k in range(1, r + 1)]\n                 + [f\"f{k}_lag1\" for k in range(1, r + 1)] + [\"lpr_1y_z\"])\n        fit = audited_fit(X, y)\n        beta = fit[\"beta\"]\n        p = float(norm.cdf(np.r_[1.0, x_test] @ beta))\n        preds.append({\n            \"model\": \"probit_dynamic\",\n            \"forecast_origin\": row.forecast_origin,\n            \"target_period\": target,\n            \"y_true\": float(lmap[target]),\n            \"y_pred_proba\": p,\n            \"y_pred\": int(p >= 0.5),\n            \"fold\": str(row.fold),\n            \"seed\": ctx[\"seed\"],\n            \"r\": r,\n        })\n        conv_rows.append({\n            \"target_period\": target,\n            \"forecast_origin\": row.forecast_origin,\n            \"n_train\": len(y),\n            \"n_positive\": int(np.sum(y)),\n            \"n_negative\": int(len(y) - np.sum(y)),\n            \"r\": r,\n            \"n_regressors\": int(X.shape[1] + 1),\n            \"accepted_method\": fit[\"accepted_method\"],\n            \"converged\": fit[\"converged\"],\n            \"warnflag\": fit[\"warnflag\"],\n            \"iterations\": fit[\"iterations\"],\n            \"fopt\": fit[\"fopt\"],\n            \"score_norm\": fit[\"score_norm\"],\n            \"hessian_cond\": fit[\"hessian_cond\"],\n            \"hessian_pd\": fit[\"hessian_pd\"],\n            \"n_warnings\": fit[\"n_warnings\"],\n            \"warnings\": fit[\"warnings\"],\n            \"max_abs_coef\": float(np.max(np.abs(beta))),\n            \"max_abs_t\": float(np.nanmax(np.abs(fit[\"t\"]))),\n            \"train_prob_min\": fit[\"train_prob_min\"],\n            \"train_prob_max\": fit[\"train_prob_max\"],\n            \"train_prob_extreme_share\": fit[\"train_prob_extreme_share\"],\n            \"fallback_triggered\": fit[\"accepted_method\"] == \"ridge_probit_fallback\",\n            \"bfgs_diagnostic_converged\": fit.get(\"bfgs_diagnostic_converged\", None),\n            \"bfgs_diagnostic_max_abs_beta_diff\": fit.get(\"bfgs_diagnostic_max_abs_beta_diff\", np.nan),\n        })\n        for k, term in enumerate(terms):\n            coef_rows.append({\n                \"target_period\": target,\n                \"forecast_origin\": row.forecast_origin,\n                \"term\": term,\n                \"coef\": float(beta[k]) if k < len(beta) else np.nan,\n                \"se\": float(fit[\"se\"][k]) if k < len(fit[\"se\"]) else np.nan,\n                \"t_stat\": float(fit[\"t\"][k]) if k < len(fit[\"t\"]) else np.nan,\n                \"r\": r,\n                \"accepted_method\": fit[\"accepted_method\"],\n                \"converged\": fit[\"converged\"],\n            })\n\n    pred_df = pd.DataFrame(preds)\n    conv_df = pd.DataFrame(conv_rows)\n    coef_df = pd.DataFrame(coef_rows)\n    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    pred_df.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"probit_dynamic_predictions.csv\", index=False)\n    conv_df.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"probit_dynamic_convergence_by_fold.csv\", index=False)\n    coef_df.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"probit_dynamic_coefficients_by_fold.csv\", index=False)\n    return {\"predictions\": pred_df, \"convergence\": conv_df, \"coefficients\": coef_df}\n\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# PART 4 - evaluation and comparison\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef brier_decomposition(y: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray, bins: int = 10) -> dict[str, float]:\n    edges = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, bins + 1)\n    idx = np.clip(np.digitize(p, edges[1:-1], right=True), 0, bins - 1)\n    ybar = float(np.mean(y))\n    rel = 0.0\n    res = 0.0\n    for b in range(bins):\n        m = idx == b\n        if not m.any():\n            continue\n        w = float(m.mean())\n        pb = float(np.mean(p[m]))\n        yb = float(np.mean(y[m]))\n        rel += w * (pb - yb) ** 2\n        res += w * (yb - ybar) ** 2\n    unc = ybar * (1 - ybar)\n    return {\"reliability\": rel, \"resolution\": res, \"uncertainty\": unc,\n            \"brier_from_decomposition\": rel - res + unc}\n\n\ndef evaluate(y: np.ndarray, p: np.ndarray, threshold: float = 0.5) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    y = np.asarray(y, float)\n    p = np.asarray(p, float)\n    cls = (p >= threshold).astype(int)\n    brier = float(np.mean((p - y) ** 2))\n    auc = float(roc_auc_score(y, p)) if len(np.unique(y)) == 2 else float(\"nan\")\n    acc = float(np.mean(cls == y))\n    cm = confusion_matrix(y, cls, labels=[0, 1])\n    tn, fp, fn, tp = int(cm[0, 0]), int(cm[0, 1]), int(cm[1, 0]), int(cm[1, 1])\n    sens = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) else float(\"nan\")\n    spec = tn / (tn + fp) if (tn + fp) else float(\"nan\")\n    bal = float(np.nanmean([sens, spec]))\n    ll = float(log_loss(y, np.clip(p, 1e-12, 1 - # Option A Probit - diagnostic and sensitivity summary

This file is generated by `code/approach1_regime_diagnostics.py`. It is not `report.md` and makes no final model-selection decision.

## 1. Optimizer audit of the existing primary Probit

- Folds audited: 82.
- Accepted estimator counts: `{'statsmodels_probit_newton': 82}`.
- Newton converged: 82/82; non-converged: 0; missing status: 0.
- Folds with warnings: 0; warnflag != 0: 0; ridge fallbacks: 0.
- Hessian condition number: median 64.2554, max 436.6827; minimum Hessian eigenvalue 0.0063.
- Maximum |coefficient|: 4.6922; maximum |t|: 4.5805.
- Training fitted-probability range: [0.0000, 0.9312]; folds with >25% extreme training probabilities: 0.
- OOS test probabilities outside [0.01, 0.99]: 7 below 0.01 and 2 above 0.99.
- Maximum absolute difference between the audited reproduction and the saved primary probabilities: 0.000000000000.

**Audit interpretation.** The audit reproduces the saved primary predictions to numerical precision. The primary fit did not silently fall back to ridge, and the convergence status recorded by the optimizer is available in `optimizer_convergence_by_fold.csv`. Any instability flags are diagnostic signals, not proof of a failed fit. The audit does not alter the primary results.

## 2. Inner-CV factor-count sensitivity

- Selected ranks: `{1: 76, 5: 6}`; primary ranks: `{3: 61, 4: 21}`.
- Fallback folds (inner CV unreliable): 0/82.
- Mean inner Brier at the selected rank: 0.2116; at the primary rank: 0.2434.
- primary_probit: Brier 0.2517, AUC 0.5953, accuracy 0.5976, balanced accuracy 0.5492, sensitivity 0.4074, specificity 0.6909.
- inner_cv_rank_probit: Brier 0.2477, AUC 0.6114, accuracy 0.6098, balanced accuracy 0.5488, sensitivity 0.3704, specificity 0.7273.
- prior_frequency: Brier 0.2321, AUC 0.5997, accuracy 0.6707, balanced accuracy 0.5000, sensitivity 0.0000, specificity 1.0000.
- persistence: Brier 0.2439, AUC 0.7239, accuracy 0.7561, balanced accuracy 0.7239, sensitivity 0.6296, specificity 0.8182.

The rank-selection experiment uses only inner expanding-window Brier scores computed from data available at each outer origin. OOS metrics are reported for comparison only and did not drive selection.

## 3. Dynamic Probit sensitivity

- Dynamic model convergence: 82/82 converged; non-converged 0; ridge fallbacks 0.
- Hessian condition median 236.3715, max 1852.2945; max |coefficient| 6.8007; max |t| 4.0639.
- Folds with >25% extreme training probabilities: 0.
- dynamic_probit: Brier 0.2860, AUC 0.5253, accuracy 0.5366, balanced accuracy 0.4754, sensitivity 0.2963, specificity 0.6545.

The dynamic specification adds one-month-lagged factors from the same fold-specific PCA basis. The additional regressors raise overfitting and separation risk; the convergence and coefficient-instability diagnostics are reported alongside the OOS metrics.

## 4. Calibration, ranking and accuracy

Brier score is a proper probabilistic score; AUC measures ranking only; accuracy and balanced accuracy depend on the fixed 0.5 threshold. The comparison table in `probit_diagnostic_comparison.csv` reports all three, plus Brier reliability/resolution/uncertainty and calibration-in-the-large. A higher accuracy at 0.5 is not by itself evidence of a better probabilistic model.

## 5. Limitations and risks

- The primary specification remains the GDP-nowcast-selected rank. Every experiment here is a sensitivity.
- The inner-CV rank experiment uses the outer fold's PCA basis (fitted only on data up to the outer origin) for the inner Probit fits; the control standardization is recomputed on each inner training sample. No outer test observation is used.
- The training sample is short (74-155 labels, 14-41 positives at the 50 threshold). Coefficient stability is limited.
- The 49.5 sensitivity has only 13 OOS positives and is kept as a separate reference; it is not mixed with the 50-threshold comparison.
- Differences in OOS metrics between the primary, rank-CV and dynamic models are descriptive. They are not a basis for claiming that one model is generally better, and no final selection is made here.
- Diagnostic validation: 24/24 checks passed; all passed: True.

```json
  "newString": "    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)\n    coefs = pd.DataFrame(coef_rows)\n    preds = pd.DataFrame(pred_rows)\n\n    def coef_summary(coef_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:\n        out = []\n        for term, g in coef_df.groupby(\"term\"):\n            vals = g[\"coef\"].dropna().to_numpy(float)\n            if len(vals) == 0:\n                continue\n            mean_v = float(np.mean(vals))\n            out.append({\n                \"term\": term,\n                \"n_folds\": int(len(vals)),\n                \"mean_coef\": mean_v,\n                \"sd_coef\": float(np.std(vals, ddof=1)) if len(vals) > 1 else np.nan,\n                \"min_coef\": float(np.min(vals)),\n                \"max_coef\": float(np.max(vals)),\n                \"n_positive\": int(np.sum(vals > 0)),\n                \"n_negative\": int(np.sum(vals < 0)),\n                \"sign_stability\": float(np.mean(np.sign(vals) == np.sign(mean_v))) if mean_v != 0 else np.nan,\n                \"max_abs_t\": float(np.nanmax(np.abs(g[\"t_stat\"].to_numpy(float)))),\n            })\n        return pd.DataFrame(out)\n\n    csum = coef_summary(coefs)\n\n    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    df.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"optimizer_convergence_by_fold.csv\", index=False)\n    coefs.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"optimizer_coefficients_by_fold.csv\", index=False)\n    csum.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"optimizer_coefficient_summary.csv\", index=False)\n    preds.to_csv(OUT_DIR / \"probit_primary_audited_predictions.csv\", index=False)"
}
```
